metadata.baselineStatus: historical-audit-only; current approved identity assets are recorded in source-assets.json
metadata.method: SHA-256 and dimensions computed by reading files in place or by read-only public HTTP. No asset was copied into the new project.
sourceNotes: Local candidates come only from /data/HomeWorks/DT-Portal-main, which remained read-only.
Repository presence is not ownership or redistribution permission.
Generated wordmarks are labelled placeholders, not verified identities.
Open-font candidates require licence/copyright retention and final source/destination hash records. Inter is prohibited by the approved plan.
metadata.clearanceRule: No screenshot, photo, logo, icon or social card is cleared without ownership/licence evidence and an owner approval date.
